name: High Seas Handyman & Services
dm_message: Hi! This is Michael from Merktop. Saw High Seas Handyman & Services' 5.0 rating on Google (37 reviews) and noticed there's no website yet, so I built a free sample one: https://siteforge-demos.odd-forest-9504.workers.dev/high-seas-handyman-lakeland/ It doesn't touch your business in any way. Like it? We can move it to your own domain. Not for you? We'll take it down, no obligation.

owner.name: Gustavo Altamar
owner.note: Confirmed across 3 independent public sources: bizapedia.com ('GUSTAVO ALTAMAR DBA HIGH SEAS HANDYMAN AND SERVICES'), a LinkedIn profile titled 'Gustavo Altamar - High Seas Handyman & Services', and the nears.me directory profile ('Owner Gustavo Altamar operates this handyman service with over 20 years of construction and customer service experience, serving the Polk County area since 2012'). Florida Sunbiz LLC filing (search.sunbiz.org, entity L22000107635) also lists Yadira N Pena Cordero as Manager and Gustavo A Altamar Rodriguez as Authorized Member; public-facing sources consistently present Gustavo as the operator, so the site credits him as owner.

founded_year_source: nears.me directory profile: 'serving the Polk County area since 2012'. Consistent across multiple independent search summaries (WebSearch results referencing bisprofiles.com and nears.me).
phone_source: Google Maps live listing (gmaps_detail.js), field 'Phone: +1 321-277-8932', confirmed across 6 separate live fetches on 2026-08-14. Matches exactly across bisprofiles.com, giftly.com and nears.me listings, and the phone number given in the task brief.
email_note: No public email found. Searched WebSearch for business name + email/contact, checked bisprofiles.com, nears.me, giftly.com, bizapedia.com, sunbiz.org LLC filing, and attempted Instagram/Facebook profile fetches (blocked by rate limiting / login walls). No mailto or email address surfaced on any source. Left null per no-invention rule.
instagram_note: Public profile URL found via WebSearch (multiple independent hits titled 'High Seas Handyman & Services (@highseashandyman)' and a Reels post under the same handle). Could not fetch bio/content directly (Instagram blocked automated fetch with HTTP 429 on repeated attempts), so bio text and follower count are not verified, only the profile's existence and handle.
facebook_note: Public page URL found via WebSearch, titled 'High Seas Handyman & Services | Davenport FL | Facebook'. Could not fetch page content directly (redirected to Facebook login wall), so only the page's existence and URL are verified, not its content.
address_note: Google Maps does not publish a street address for this listing (address field returned null across 6 live fetches; consistent with a service-area business with no public storefront). The LLC's registered address on file with the Florida Division of Corporations (155 Margate Drive, Davenport, FL 33897) is a business registration address, not a customer-facing location, so it was not used as a site address. Per pipeline rule ('sin direccion completa = omitir mapa y usar foto real'), the map iframe was omitted and replaced with a real work photo in the Service Area section.
service_area_note: The Google Maps pin coordinates for this listing (28.2146625, -81.61864) sit near Davenport/Loughman, FL, roughly 30 miles east of Lakeland proper. The business's Nextdoor business page lists confirmed service cities as Davenport, Clermont, Windermere and Apopka, FL, and separately states the business has been 'serving the Polk County area since 2012' (Polk County includes both Davenport and Lakeland, its county seat and largest city). Google's own local search surfaced this listing as a top result for the query 'High Seas Handyman Lakeland FL' (verified live via gmaps_discover.js), consistent with a service-area business whose Google Business Profile covers a radius that includes Lakeland. The site therefore frames the business as serving 'Polk County and Central Florida, including Lakeland, Davenport, Clermont, Windermere and Apopka' rather than claiming a Lakeland headquarters or address, which is not supported by any source.
hours_note: Monday-Friday 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM, Saturday 8:30 AM - 2:00 PM, Sunday closed. Source: Google Maps live listing (gmaps_detail.js hours field), confirmed via live fetch on 2026-08-14 (full weekly schedule captured once; other fetches returned partial/cached views but agreed on the days captured).
rating_source: Google Maps live listing, confirmed via multiple separate live fetches (gmaps_detail.js) on 2026-08-14: rating 5.0, review summary block explicitly states '37 reviews'. Matches the rating/count given in the discovery brief exactly.
own_site_check: gmaps_detail.js confirmed website: null across 6 live fetches (Maps panel shows 'Add website' button). WebSearch for 'High Seas Handyman Lakeland FL website' and 'High Seas Handyman & Services Davenport website' returned no own-domain result: only third-party directory/listing pages (Nextdoor, Yelp, bisprofiles.com, bizapedia.com, sunbiz.org, giftly.com, nears.me, Instagram, Facebook). No candidate domain (e.g. highseashandyman.com) appeared in any search result. Conclusion: has_own_site is false.
services_note: No booking platform and no published price list. Services below are derived from three real, verifiable sources: (1) Google's own 'service mentions' aggregation on the live Maps listing (aria-label tags with review counts: 'house painting, mentioned in 5 reviews', 'kitchen faucet repair, mentioned in 2 reviews', 'pressure washing, mentioned in 3 reviews', 'bathroom remodeling, mentioned in 2 reviews'), (2) a verbatim Google review describing bathroom shower hardware and lighting fixture installation, and (3) the business's own uploaded Google Maps photos, which show real completed work: a marble-tiled walk-in shower with dual shower heads, a bathroom vanity and shower remodel, a wood ceiling fan installation, and a bedroom remodel with wall-mounted TV. The broader service list (flooring, irrigation, garage door service, electrical, tree/lawn service, stucco, plumbing, junk removal) is drawn from the nears.me directory business profile, an independent third-party source. No prices shown anywhere; the site uses 'Call for a quote' throughout.

reviews.text: Gus and Carlos did an amazing job installing my new bathroom shower hardware and lighting fixtures! They were very professional and the pride they take in their work is unbelievable! I will definitely be calling on them to help me with other projects in the near future!
reviews.author: Mark Burnett

reviews_note: Only one verbatim quote with an attributed author name could be captured directly from the live Google Maps reviews panel (gmaps_detail.js), despite repeated live fetches (Google served a heavier, review-populated view of the listing only once out of ~13 attempts; subsequent fetches returned a lighter cached view without the reviews tab populated). A second review excerpt surfaced via WebSearch summarization of the business's Yelp page ('Gus with High Seas Handy man services is just great!! He is always willing to help and does a great job') but without an attributed author name, so it was not used as a testimonial per the no-invented-attribution rule. Per pipeline rule, the Reviews section uses the SIN-testimonios 3-card 'Why choose us' variant (built from real, sourced Google service-mention data, not fabricated quotes) plus the one verified verbatim quote featured as a highlighted review, while still displaying the real 5.0/37 rating.

photos.source_note: All 6 photos pulled directly from the business's own Google Maps photo listing (139+ photos on file) via a Playwright scrape of the Maps photo panel, downloaded at full resolution and verified with `file` as valid JPEGs before resizing to max 1000px width at ~82% JPEG quality. No stock imagery, no other business's photos. Two additional photos from the same Maps gallery were reviewed and discarded: a nighttime house-exterior holiday-lights photo (not clearly demonstrating handyman work) and a bathroom vanity photo containing a worker's reflection in the mirror (excluded per the no-selfies-in-gallery rule).

palette_note: Deep navy + brass/gold trade palette (accent-deep #123a5e, accent-mid #3f7398) on a warm sand/cream base, derived from the business's own Google Maps cover photo: a navy-blue banner with a nautical ship's-wheel-and-anchor logo mark over an ocean cliff photo. Dark-band (CTA/footer) uses a deep navy-black (#0d1c2c/#081420) with a brass/gold accent (#d8b872), echoing the merktop-badge gold and the brand's nautical identity. The logo banner itself is used as a low-opacity background layer in the final CTA section.
cta_channel: No booking platform, no confirmed WhatsApp. Primary CTA is tel:+13212778932 throughout (nav, hero, services cards, CTA final, book-float button); secondary CTA is sms:+13212778932 ('Send a text').
build_note: Built from templates/light/index.html (Amani ejemplar), re-skinned and adapted following the 239-handyman-can-capecoral precedent (closest existing handyman/adapted-variant build in the repo) for structure: no booking CTA, no invented prices ('Call for a quote' throughout), map replaced with a real photo (no public address), and a SIN-testimonios review section (3 real-data cards + 1 verified verbatim quote) instead of a full quote carousel. Bilingual data-es/data-en added throughout per DESIGN.md (template light/index.html ships with no bilingual mechanism by default); default language English (lang='en'), matching the business's English-language public presence (no Spanish evidence found in reviews, listings or social profiles) despite the Hispanic ownership names. GATE OK: python3 scripts/gate.py high-seas-handyman-lakeland --lang en --forbid "Mizu,Hialeah,Amani,Miami,Cape Coral,239 Handyman,Flagami".
